dominant_strengths: Elegant serif 'Notifications' headline contrasts nicely with sans-serif buttons, signaling editorial polish on a calm dark canvas.
Color-coded dot indicators (green/blue/amber) form a clean semantic palette with good contrast against muted button outlines.
Restrained dark gradient background avoids visual noise and lets the trio of action chips stay focal.
dominant_weaknesses: Composition floats lifelessly mid-canvas with massive empty top half; no anchoring grid, mark, or toast preview to balance.
No visible toast artifact or stack — the brief is 'notification-stack' but only triggers exist, leaving the core component unshown.
Innovation is near zero: standard outlined chips with dots, a pattern seen in countless component libraries.
fix_priorities: Show an actual stacked notification example on screen (default state) to fulfill the brief, not just triggers.
Tighten vertical composition — raise the block or add supporting content so negative space feels intentional, not abandoned.
Differentiate the trigger chips with subtle hover/pressed micro-states or iconography to elevate craft beyond template defaults.
Introduce a distinctive signature element (custom toast shape, motion choreography hint) to lift distinctiveness.
rationale.norman_balance: Mildly visceral via serif/dark mood, behaviorally clear via labeled triggers, but reflectively thin since nothing memorable or system-defining lingers.
rationale.intent_fit: Partially fits — it sets up notification triggers but fails to actually present the stack itself, which is the brief's core subject.
